name: Glaucous-Vortex
description: From orbit the planet is a painted oval, serene; up close it is violence given volume. Hurricane cells wider than moons chase each other along the shear lines, and the lightning never quite stops.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the derelict space station in orbit left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
